name: Biogas reforming to hydrogen
principle: Upgraded biogas or biomethane is steam-reformed like natural gas to make hydrogen, or used as the hydrogen feed for products such as ammonia. The hydrogen is renewable by feedstock, and CO2 capture can make it carbon-negative. In Cubatão, Brazil, Yara started ammonia production from biomethane, with a goal of 6 to 7 ktpa.

performance.metric: Yara Cubatão ammonia target from biomethane

source.note: IEA Global Hydrogen Review 2025 (collected in corpus/iea-reports): Yara Cubatão

performance.metric: hydrogen yield per Nm3 biogas, steam reforming
performance.basis: Comparative study of steam and dry reforming of biogas: steam reforming gives 0.14-0.19 kg H2/Nm3 with 0.048-0.075 MWh/kg H2 specific energy.
